## Files included in SWS

All SVG files are in `sws-editor/public/images/mdi/`.
They are served at runtime under `/images/mdi/<filename>.svg`.

A curated industrial subset was downloaded — not the full library (~7 400 icons).
See `scripts/fetch-image-catalog.sh` for the exact list of downloaded icons.

## Modifications

None. Files are used as-is from the upstream SVG source directory.

## Attribution requirement (Apache 2.0)

Apache 2.0 requires that the license text and any NOTICE file be reproduced
in distributions. The license text is in `third-party/licenses/Apache-2.0.txt`.
The upstream repository does not ship a separate NOTICE file.
